title: fix: regenerate pnpm-lock.yaml for hotcrm/packages/ai dependencies
body:
Vercel build fails with `ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE` because `examples/hotcrm/packages/ai/package.json` added 5 dependencies not reflected in the lockfile.

- Regenerated `pnpm-lock.yaml` with the hotcrm submodule checked out, resolving the missing specifiers:
  - `@objectstack/cli@^3.0.3`
  - `@objectstack/spec@^3.0.3`
  - `typescript@^5.9.3`
  - `axios@^1.13.5`
  - `zod@^4.3.6`
- Verified `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` succeeds across all 61 workspace projects
